episodes.synopsis: Emma, an honest and hardworking young maid, never felt her place in life to be a burden. But then she met William, a member of the gentry and the eldest son of a wealthy family. His warm smile and earnest affection threaten to capture her heart... but can love truly conquer all?
episodes.title: The Gift

episodes.synopsis: William's father forces him to attend a ball, where he is reintroduced to Eleanor, who happens to be making her debut into society, but Emma is still in on his mind...
episodes.title: Two Worlds

episodes.synopsis: William's friend, Prince Hakim, arrives for a visit and takes William on an impromptu elephant ride that leaves the Londoner motion sick. Luckily, Kelly Stowner's residence is near by, so he can recover, but will he find himself with an unexpected rival for Emma's attention?
episodes.title: The Confession

episodes.synopsis: By chance, William and Hakim run meet Emma at Mudie's lending library.
episodes.title: Mudie's

episodes.synopsis: Kelly Stowner and Emma prepare for a dinner party.
episodes.title: Dinner Party

episodes.synopsis: William and his father pay a visit to his former governess, Kelly Stownar.
episodes.title: The Visit

episodes.synopsis: On her day off, William takes Emma to see the exhibits at the world-famous Crystal Palace.
episodes.title: Crystal Palace

episodes.synopsis: Mrs. Stowner's pocket watch is in need of repair, so Emma takes it to be fixed.
episodes.title: The Pocket Watch

episodes.synopsis: Emma reminisces about her life with Mrs. Stowner.
episodes.title: Alone

episodes.synopsis: Emma visits with Al, and William's father conspires to set his son up with Eleanor.
episodes.title: The Past

episodes.synopsis: Emma prepares to leave London. Will William meet her in time?
episodes.title: Lilies of the Valley
